name: Corn-Soybean Spread Mean Reversion (Crush Divergence)
description: Dollar-neutral spread strategy trading ZC (corn) vs ZS (soybeans). Entry is triggered by divergence between the corn-soy ratio z-score and the soybean crush spread z-score. When the ratio is cheap (z < -1.5) but crush margins are healthy (z > 0), go long corn / short beans. When the ratio is expensive (z > +1.5) but crush is compressed (z < 0), go short corn / long beans. Exits occur when ratio z-score partially reverts toward zero (-0.5 / +0.5 thresholds). 20% allocation per leg for dollar neutrality.
source:
# ============================================================================
# Corn-Soybean Spread Mean Reversion with Crush Spread Divergence
# ============================================================================
# Signal: Divergence between corn/soy price ratio z-score and crush spread z-score
# Long ZC / Short ZS when ratio_z < -1.5 AND crush_z > 0
# Short ZC / Long ZS when ratio_z > +1.5 AND crush_z < 0
# Exit when ratio_z reverts to -0.5 (from longs) or +0.5 (from shorts)
# Position sizing: 20% of capital per leg (40% total deployed)
# ============================================================================

# --- Primary data source (runs on ZC and ZS universe) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Reference futures for all four legs (loaded identically on every asset) ---
# Corn — reference_futures provides continuous front-month data directly
zc_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZC")()
zc_close = zc_ref.c

# Soybeans
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
zs_close = zs_ref.c

# Soybean Meal (ZM) — quoted in $/ton
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZM")()
zm_close = zm_ref.c

# Soybean Oil (ZL) — quoted in cents/lb
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZL")()
zl_close = zl_ref.c

# --- Signal computation ---
# Corn-soy price ratio
corn_soy_ratio = zc_close / zs_close

# Soybean crush spread ($/bushel):
# 1 bushel soybeans produces ~48 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil
# crush_spread = ZM * 0.024 + ZL * 0.11 - ZS / 100
crush_spread = zm_close * 0.024 + zl_close * 0.11 - zs_close / 100

# 252-day rolling z-scores
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=252)(corn_soy_ratio)
crush_zscore = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Entry conditions (persistent thresholds) ---
# Long corn / short beans: ratio is cheap, crush margins healthy
long_corn_cond = ratio_zscore < -1.5 and crush_zscore > 0
# Short corn / long beans: ratio is expensive, crush compressed
short_corn_cond = ratio_zscore > 1.5 and crush_zscore < 0

# --- Exit conditions (partial reversion) ---
exit_long_corn = ratio_zscore > -0.5
exit_short_corn = ratio_zscore < 0.5

# --- State management via hold_until ---
# Long corn state: enters when conditions met, exits on partial reversion or reversal
want_long_corn = hold_until()(enter=long_corn_cond, exit=exit_long_corn or short_corn_cond)
# Short corn state: enters when conditions met, exits on partial reversion or reversal
want_short_corn = hold_until()(enter=short_corn_cond, exit=exit_short_corn or long_corn_cond)

# Detect transitions out of held state (for closing zones)
was_long_corn = want_long_corn >> 1
was_short_corn = want_short_corn >> 1
close_long_corn = was_long_corn and not want_long_corn and not want_short_corn
close_short_corn = was_short_corn and not want_short_corn and not want_long_corn

# --- Asset identification ---
is_zc = is_asset_ref(ticker="ZC")()
is_zs = is_asset_ref(ticker="ZS")()

# --- ZC signals: long corn = long ZC, short corn = short ZC ---
zc_long_entry = is_zc and (want_long_corn or close_short_corn)
zc_short_entry = is_zc and (want_short_corn or close_long_corn)

# --- ZS signals: OPPOSITE of ZC ---
# Long corn / short beans → ZS is short
# Short corn / long beans → ZS is long
zs_long_entry = is_zs and (want_short_corn or close_long_corn)
zs_short_entry = is_zs and (want_long_corn or close_short_corn)

# --- Combined entry signals per asset ---
long_entry = zc_long_entry or zs_long_entry
short_entry = zc_short_entry or zs_short_entry

# === EXECUTION ===
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)
